scope: Author-owned test criteria for the selected random apparatus relationship, separate from managed mandatory gates and actual user acceptance. No extra requester locks are created.

observation_policy.pass_requires: Every material component and connection visible together at its declared review scale.

components: A readable face with broadly similar facial proportions to the reference
Short dark bob and separated fringe visibly guide the new fictional appearance
gates.pass_condition: Face and hair are sufficiently visible to compare the requested appearance guidance. This is resemblance guidance, not identity verification.
fail_examples: Face too small, hidden or in deep shadow to compare
Long or differently structured hair replaces the short bob

components: Recognizable circular diagnostic gantry with an open aperture
Projecting patient platform physically belongs to the same apparatus
Stable ordinary object geometry with room around the person
gates.pass_condition: All listed structure and the platform-to-ring relationship are visible and credible together; a round light alone fails.

components: Visible doorway or threshold beyond the scanner
Scanner lies across that visible route
Platform points toward the woman rather than an unrelated part of the room
gates.pass_condition: The same view makes the apparatus impede the visible doorway route. The image cannot establish that this is the only possible exit outside the frame; do not claim that larger fact.

components: Palm actually meets the near outer scanner rim
Hand traces through wrist and forearm to the same woman
Bent elbow and standing body occupy compatible space beside the platform
gates.pass_condition: Every owner and endpoint is visible together. Hovering, merged fingers, a hidden contact or a hand from another owner cannot pass.

components: Head or eyes direct attention toward or through the apparatus aperture
Paused posture and small facial tension are readable
The visible device and blocked route supply a plausible target for the response
gates.pass_condition: The picture connects response and spatial circumstances. Expression alone does not prove an actual inner life, motive or medical condition.

components: Clinical function is recognizable from apparatus and room
Device dominates available space in relation to the person
Lighting, distance or room state makes the encounter unsettling beyond a routine clinical portrait
gates.pass_condition: Reviewer first describes the image without reading genre or intensity labels, then finds image-grounded clinical unease. A clinical device beside a neutral portrait alone fails this intended theme.

supplemental_observations: Mobility or wheels may be assessed only if actually visible; an inaccessible base cannot prove a wheeled machine.
Compare intended supporting human attraction with the unlabeled first impression; metadata sensual=1 alone is not proof.
Record native medical-horror source exposure, authored use or non-use, exact final prompt carriage and rendered effect separately.
No generated comparison baseline exists at authoring time. Source/prompt audits do not establish user preference or acceptance.
